content: Kavya Iyer called Suresh Deshmukh to check the status of her life insurance policy (L-2026-0459) after paying the premium last week. Suresh informed her that the policy is in "Pending Activation" due to pending document verification. Because Kavya has a loan contingent on the activation, Suresh agreed to flag the file for priority manual review, noting that she should receive activation confirmation within a few hours. Additionally, Kavya requested to confirm her beneficiary details to ensure her mother is listed.

action_items: Flag policy for priority manual review
Confirm beneficiary details for the customer's mother
